chains.title: The Common Passage
chains.summary: A merchant fails to arrive. Tobin asks you to investigate the Kelp Reach shipping routes. The rescue guarantee brings Della Venn into the dispute.

stages.title: Overdue Merchant
stages.body:
Tobin Hale: ‘A merchant out of Kelp Reach missed its berth. The departure report is dated; I cannot tell you where it is now. Find a loaded independent convoy and bring its passage safely into harbor. Take a paid escort only after its captain shows you the actual terms.’

You can keep your Tinwake and your other work. The client pays from its own operating purse after delivery. Your wages, fuel and repairs remain your costs.
stages.nextAction: Review the Kelp Reach route and return allowance. Approach a peaceful loaded merchant, accept its escort and remain within 600 units.

stages.title: Escort a loaded merchant
stages.body: Keep the original loaded boats together until they sell their cargo at the named harbor. Any interception requires their physical escape. Losing a carrier, leaving the protection radius or withdrawing ends the contract under its normal refund rules. You can seek another actual client after closing a failed passage.
stages.nextAction: Collect the bound client's escort fee at the delivery harbor, then return to Tobin at Brass Haven.

choices.text: Report the completed passage to Tobin

stages.title: The rescue guarantee
stages.body:
Tobin Hale: ‘The cargo arrived. The merchant's fee is yours. This claim is separate.’

Tobin opens a notice from Della Venn, the Compact's charter administrator. ‘My wardens keep these routes open. A captain who asks for rescue accepts our service terms. Your escort does not cancel the earlier debt.’

Tobin recognizes the countersignature. He financed the guarantee when the harbors needed protection; he did not tell you how a missed payment could transfer control of a boat.
stages.nextAction: Ask Tobin why his signature appears on Venn’s guarantee.

choices.text: Ask who authorized the seizure terms

consequences.reason: Returned with a paid escort's actual delivery and questioned the rescue guarantee

stages.title: Second Signature
stages.body:
Tobin lays Venn's notice beside a harbor bounty. ‘The raiders named in these claims collected under my guarantee. I financed it. I thought I was paying for protection. Find their original boats, then keep what you can recover or secure. A bounty paid for someone else's victory will not tell us what happened aboard them.’

Take only the harbor's existing funded contract. After a physical encounter, paid fitting recovery or an intact captured hull can establish original property. Its identity and your current custody matter. If the source is actually lost, report that outcome plainly; the investigation creates no replacement boat or prize.
stages.nextAction: Review the actual bounty, reacquire its boats through the coastal watch, and bring original secured property to a harbor. Claim or withdraw the contract before sending Tobin the report.

choices.text: Send Tobin the report with secured original property
Explicitly report that no original property is retained
choices.tradeoff: Available only after actual loss or a paid public defeat confirmation. This awards no property and makes no claim that you witnessed someone else's battle.

stages.title: Tobin's countersignature
stages.body:
Tobin replies in writing: ‘I checked the seizure clause against my guarantee. It permits the administrator to take control of a boat after an unpaid rescue claim. My signature made that enforceable. Public money stood behind it.’

‘I kept saying we needed the next convoy protected. That did not entitle me to hide these terms from its captain. Wren is trying to get working boats out of Kelp Reach. She needs to know what I signed before she asks anyone to rely on a different promise.’
stages.nextAction: Keep the actual property or recorded loss, and read the lead concerning Wren and Kelp Reach.

consequences.reason: Required Tobin to acknowledge his funded guarantee and its seizure terms

stages.title: Exit Channel
stages.body: Wren has asked about the working boats leaving Kelp Reach. This next campaign operation is not available in this version. Your completed investigation, original equipment, losses and Tobin's admission remain saved.
stages.nextAction: Continue harbor work, fleet building or exploration until the next campaign operation is available.

gate.message: The next campaign operation is not available in this version.

chains.title: Tobin: The guarantee
chains.summary: Ask Tobin to read the seizure clause, or explain why he signed it. This optional conversation does not gate the campaign.

stages.title: Read It Aloud
stages.body:
Tobin sets the guarantee on the desk. ‘We were keeping boats moving. I thought the limits were obvious.’

You can ask him to read the seizure authority without paraphrasing, or explain why he accepted it. Hearing him out does not commit you to his explanation.

choices.text: Ask Tobin to read the seizure clause as written
Ask why Tobin signed the guarantee

stages.title: Tobin's answer
stages.body:
Tobin reads the authority allowing an unpaid rescue claim to become control of the boat. He stops at his own signature.

‘I was afraid no one would back the next sailing. I signed wider powers than I could justify. When people asked what the guarantee meant, I argued about the boats we had already saved.’

He leaves the paper where you can read it. You do not have to accept his explanation, forgive him or buy anything.
stages.nextAction: End this conversation whenever you are ready.

stages.title: The guarantee conversation is recorded
stages.body: Tobin's explanation is retained. His later conversation will be available as the campaign develops. This optional lead places no condition on your main voyage.
stages.nextAction: Continue the main campaign or ordinary harbor work.

gate.message: No further Tobin contact job is available in this version.
